responsibility: Holds the Blackfin machine-description patterns for atomic synchronization builtins, implementing fetch-and-op and compare-and-swap operations as target-specific RTL expands and insns. Rather than describing native lock-free instructions, it lowers GCC sync operations into calls through designated helper entry points, forcing legal address registers and clobbers and using UNSPEC_ATOMIC patterns that the rest of the backend includes from bfin.md when the selected OS ABI supports sync calls.
